## readContractRestructured() function

When reading contracts, viem converts onchain tuples into arrays -- even when tuple values are named in the ABI. \[They argue\](https://viem.sh/docs/faq\#why-is-a-contract-function-return-type-returning-an-array-instead-of-an-object) this information loss is justified, as it eliminates the ambiguity between tuple return types and struct return types. This wrapper converts viem's arrays back to objects, \_as if\_ the onchain method returned a struct.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function readContractRestructured<chain extends Chain | undefined, const abi extends Abi, name extends AbiItemName<abi> & ContractFunctionName<abi, "view" | "pure">, const args extends ContractFunctionArgs<abi, "view" | "pure", name>>(client: Client<Transport, chain>, parameters: ReadContractParameters<abi, name, args>): Promise<ZipToObject<ExtractAbiFunctionForArgs<abi, "pure" | "view", name, args>["outputs"], Awaited<import("viem").ContractFunctionReturnType<abi, "pure" | "view", name, args>> extends infer T ? T extends Awaited<import("viem").ContractFunctionReturnType<abi, "pure" | "view", name, args>> ? T extends readonly unknown[] ? T : never : never : never>>;
```

T extends Awaited&lt;import("viem").ContractFunctionReturnType&lt;abi, "pure" \| "view", name, args&gt;&gt; ? T extends readonly unknown\[\] ? T : never : never : never&gt;&gt;

An object whose keys are the named ABI outputs and whose values are the tuple elements.

## Example


```ts
import { readContractRestructured } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk-viem";

const market = await readContractRestructured(client, {
  address: morpho,
  abi: blueAbi,
  functionName: "market",
  args: [marketId],
});
```
